policy: The certified June UK national battery declared as data (microcosm#611): the two build preflights plus the eleven-gate terminal battery, thresholds carried as entry parameters at their exact certified values with no discretionary headroom. The input-mass and QRF-tail entries stay runtime-armed pending the microcosm#630 adjudication, whose receipted values land here as parameter edits. A delivered-take-up gate is deferred until the shared gate vocabulary grows a take-up name; every gate the UK runs today is declared below.

gates.notes: Frameless preflight mirror of the US cheap preflight: the committed coverage manifest must match the engine's current variable surface, aborting before source stages on graph or reference drift.
Frameless preflight over the materialized stage names: every family the coverage manifest marks required_at_build must have its build stage scheduled before any stage runs.
The release input-coverage contract over the built frame: required columns present and populated per the committed manifest resource in this package.
No constant non-structural columns on any entity table. The microcosm#630 source-year finding lands here as a reviewed exclusion once its register entry is approved.

gates.notes: Zero household weight is legal only inside the two reviewed June SPI-synthetic strata, each capped at its shipped size.
Effective sample size of the positive household weights must stay above one percent of the positive-weight count (microcosm#609).

Exact certified June measurement (max positive weight over positive median), an acceptance fence with no discretionary headroom. The microcosm#630 receipted full-scale re-baseline replaces this number as a reviewed parameter edit, never a loosen-to-pass.
Every fit-produced weight column carries a completed audit record. Armed by the SPI income stage; an absent audit is not a passing audit.

reviewed_exclusions.person.incapacity_benefit_reported: The enhanced FRS stores this legacy reported-benefit input as an all-zero layer; the candidate must drop dead zero layers.

gates.notes: Reviewed candidate-only fields from the June UK prototype (source provenance or genuine additional model inputs, not incumbent-surface losses) plus the one reviewed reference-side exclusion. The two hard-required columns that may never be waived stay a code-level guard, per the microcosm#327 rule that a parity comparison's registers are declared inputs.
Candidate and incumbent calibration target surfaces must agree exactly; the gate takes no tunable parameters.
Every calibration target within twenty-five percent absolute relative error, the certified June acceptance bound.

Weighted input-mass parity against the frozen 131-column enhanced-FRS reference. The reference is a declared input pinned by identity and canonical digest (the totals stay uncommitted under the UKDS licence); numeric tolerances stay runtime-armed pending microcosm#630 and land here when adjudicated. Reviewed exclusions live in the named register resource of this package.

Weighted tail-concentration audit of the QRF-imputed output columns derived from the HMRC source manifest. Thresholds stay runtime-armed pending microcosm#630 and land here when adjudicated. Reviewed exclusions live in the named register resource of this package.
